mission.title: Orison Relief: Medium Fabrication Order
mission.description:
Hullo,

Crusader have been in touch to say that the scale of the damage to their platforms is greater than they initially thought and they'll need more propulsors than they originally estimated for.

We're contracting out their request to anyone with an available Item Fabricator standing by. Though I guess you could source the propulsors some other way, but that's on you.

Once ready, deliver them to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>. Payment sent on completion.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
